2M.5 Praise should be offered to God continually.

precepts.text: My tongue shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: solutions, building one another, correction and exhortation, not backbiting, gossip, and murmuring.
precepts.point: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth: when you open your mouth, what comes out is supposed to be scriptural; your conversation has to be modeled after what this book says. When people leave this truth the Lord removes his words out of their mouth, and their whole conversation changes: nothing is left but slander, falsehood, strange doctrines, and flattering speech.

note.label: Joshua 1: The Charge to Joshua and the Formula for Success

precepts.why:
“My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.” That is the book of the law not departing out of the mouth: the tongue talking of his righteousness all the day long.

That means solutions, building one another, correction and exhortation, not backbiting, gossip, and murmuring. Your conversation has to be modeled after what this book says, and when the tongue talks of his righteousness, they that seek your hurt are confounded and brought unto shame.

points: David puts his trust in the Most High and asks never to be put to confusion, to be delivered in His righteousness and to have his cry heard.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: He asks the Most High to be his strong habitation, a place he can continually resort to, because the Lord is his rock and his fortress.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: He asks deliverance out of the hand of the wicked, the unrighteous and cruel man, calling the Most High his hope and his trust from his youth.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: The Most High has held him up from the womb and took him out of his mother's belly, so his praise is continually of Him.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: David is a wonder unto many, and the Most High is his strong refuge; he asks that his mouth be filled with praise and honor all the day.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: He pleads not to be cast off in the time of old age nor forsaken when his strength fails, because his enemies speak against him and take counsel together.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: David is not only recalling his own past, where he did things the Most High could have forsaken him for, but giving Israel understanding and direction on how to deal with enemies who speak evil, which is to go back to serving the Lord.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: The enemy says God has forsaken him, so persecute and take him, for there is none to deliver him. This is the same thing said against Israel today: persecuted by other nations and by our own people, in captivity for hundreds of years, as if no change is ever coming.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: David asks the Most High not to be far from him and to make haste for his help, that his adversaries be confounded, consumed, covered with reproach and dishonor.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: Regardless of the enemy, he will hope continually and praise the Most High more and more, showing forth His righteousness and salvation all the day.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: Because he does not know the number of his days or when his end will come, he purposes to stay obedient and follow the Most High until the day he dies.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: He will go in the strength of the Lord God and make mention of His righteousness, even of His only.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: The Most High taught David from his youth, and he has declared His wondrous works, asking that he not be forsaken now that he is old and grayheaded.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: He asks to be kept until he has showed the strength of the Most High to this generation and His power to everyone that is to come.
This is the work of men and women alike: to show forth the Lord's strength and salvation to this generation and generations to come, through our actions, our works, and our words.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: His righteousness is very high; He has done great things, and there is none like unto Him.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: The Most High has showed David great and sore troubles and chastised him, but will quicken him and bring him up again from the depths of the earth. To quicken is to make alive.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: He will increase David's greatness and comfort him on every side, and David will praise Him with the psaltery and sing to the Holy One of Israel.

note.label: Psalm 71: The Most High, My Strong Habitation

points: His lips and his redeemed soul will greatly rejoice, and his tongue will talk of the Most High's righteousness all the day long, for his enemies are brought to shame that sought his hurt.
